info.title: NYALES WEB-057 implemented local recovery API
info.description: Request schemas generated from runtime Zod validators. Local implementation only. Logical allowlist backup is a slice, not a complete point-in-time database snapshot. Drill verifies payload and counts; optional verify_objects checks bounded current R2 bytes for five supported reference families, not a copied-object or actual restore. Cross-region/provider/legal/privacy approval gates remain open.
